profile_method: New task-specific desktop-profile directory; two subsequent browser launches reuse it. Mobile uses a new empty context.
audio_observation: UI timer, controls, highlight and scrolling only; no audible listening, quality or output-route test
screen_capture_timing: Screenshot precedes DOM read; advancing timers may differ by 1–2 seconds.
state_text_scope: Outer controls and iframe controls; getClientRects does not guarantee viewport intersection. Hidden/offscreen article text was excluded.
duplicate_screenshots: Same SHA-256 shares one archived screenshot; raw_screenshot retains the original work filename.
